cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Give me the actual note, not your description.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can read it to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I want the words that don't get your emphasis.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me the one line you're using to decide for me.

mechanism: A uses its pupil old text-reading discipline to demand direct access to a director note rather than accept B performance of it.
confusable: Not demanding private information for curiosity: one line controls whether A may audition, so A narrows access to the necessary proof.
comparison: Exact wording of casting note versus access to accounts receipts.
seedUse: D132 note/emphasis/privacy/one line; S05 coached reading words before interpretation.
